definition: I. לוּז noun [masculine] almond-tree, almond-wood (Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic לוּזָא , almond ( Löw No. 319 ), whence Arabic as loan-word ( Frä 145 Lag BN 157 f. ), Ethiopic ); — Gen 30:37 ( J ; + לִבְנֶה , עַרְמוֺן לַח ) of rods stripped by Jacob.
